title: Meeting overrun hourglass
start: A tabletop hourglass beside a row of paper calendar blocks, the lime sand band marking the booked hour.
end: Sand keeps pouring past the mark, overflows the base and buries the next calendar blocks, shoving the last ones off the table edge.
apocalypse: A collapsed Ferris wheel half-buried in a grey sand dune; lime sieve conveyors sift hour tokens back out of the drift.

title: Recurring meeting zombie
start: A single recurring-invite card on a brass spindle next to an archived project box.
end: The spindle keeps stamping identical invite cards long after the project box is sealed, stacking them up the wall.
apocalypse: The carousel has sunk into layers of compressed invite cards like sediment; a lime cutting rig trims the spindle at its root.

title: Time-zone math
start: Three small desk clocks set to different hours, one meeting card sliding between them.
end: The clock hands catch on each other, gears grind, and the meeting card is dragged into the dark overnight slot.
apocalypse: Toppled clock towers across a dim plain; a lime gear train is laying a single synchronized drive shaft between them.

title: No-agenda meeting
start: A meeting-table model with one blank agenda sheet at its centre.
end: The table extends, more chairs slot in, and discussion tubes loop from seat to seat without ever reaching the blank sheet.
apocalypse: An overgrown maze ruin at landscape scale; a lime survey crawler lays one straight track from the centre to the edge.

title: Wrong window screen-share
start: A laptop mirroring one tidy window onto a small projector screen.
end: The beam splits and spills private drafts, half-finished files and open tabs across every wall of the room.
apocalypse: A shattered mirror field stretching to the horizon; lime frames re-seat one clean pane at a time.

title: Frozen video call
start: A webcam aimed at a single frosted video tile on a desk stand.
end: The tile ices over, neighbouring tiles freeze to it, and buffer icicles grow down from the monitor.
apocalypse: A glacier of fused tiles fills a valley; lime heating cables melt a narrow channel through it.

title: Double-booked room
start: A single miniature conference room with two booking tabs clipped to the door.
end: Two full meeting setups push into the same room; tables overlap and the walls bow outward.
apocalypse: The room shell is crushed flat among wrecked tables; lime rails partition the site into clean bays.

title: Quick call that isn't
start: A small fifteen-minute calendar chip on an otherwise open day strip.
end: The chip stretches like taffy across the whole day strip, pulling lunch and focus blocks along with it.
apocalypse: Hardened taffy flows have set over a miniature office district; lime cutters slice it back into segments.

title: Lost action items
start: An open notebook on a meeting table with three action-item cards tucked in.
end: The cards slip through a gap in the table and fall down a chute into the floor below.
apocalypse: A deep pit of lost cards at the foot of a collapsed tower; a lime retrieval claw lifts them out one by one.

title: Waiting-room limbo
start: A tiny virtual waiting-room lobby model with one pending tile at the door.
end: More pending tiles queue behind it in a stanchion line that snakes off the desk and across the floor.
apocalypse: A rusted field of stanchions and sagging ropes; a lime gate finally swings open at the far end.

title: Out-of-office loop
start: Two desk mail trays, each with an auto-reply envelope ready to send.
end: Each tray auto-answers the other, envelopes shuttle back and forth faster and pile up between them.
apocalypse: Drifts of envelopes between two ruined towers; a lime cut-off valve closes the channel between them.

title: CC creep
start: One outgoing envelope with a single delivery tube to one mail slot.
end: The tube keeps branching to more and more mail slots until the envelope splits into dozens of copies.
apocalypse: A fallen grid of zip lines draped over wreckage; a lime crawler restores a single clean line.

title: Subject-line fork
start: A neat thread of stacked envelopes on a single rail.
end: One altered envelope switches the rail; the thread splits into parallel tracks that never rejoin.
apocalypse: Derailed coaster tracks fan across a canyon; a lime switching mechanism rejoins them to one line.

title: @here broadcast
start: A single desk bell on one desk in a grid of quiet desks.
end: Striking the one bell triggers every bell in the grid, and the vibration rattles work off every desk.
apocalypse: Cracked bells lie scattered across a flattened office plain; lime dampers clamp them silent one by one.

title: Channel sprawl
start: One tidy chat-channel tray with a few message tiles in it.
end: The tray splits into dozens of near-identical trays, message tiles scattering between them.
apocalypse: A dried pond basin with stranded channel floats; a lime sorting flume routes them into a few channels.

title: Draft graveyard
start: An outbox tray with one half-finished envelope resting under the lid.
end: Unsent drafts accumulate until the outbox lid can no longer close and the tray jams.
apocalypse: A silted, dry flume channel; a lime pump pushes the first draft over the drop.

title: Per my last email
start: A printed email with an older quoted message folded beneath it.
end: The quote chain nests deeper and deeper; printouts stack inside printouts into a tower.
apocalypse: Collapsed nested tunnels form a mound; a lime boring rig drills straight to the original message.

title: Accidental send
start: A spring-loaded send lever holding a half-written envelope.
end: The lever fires early; the envelope launches and recall mechanisms chase it down the table.
apocalypse: A crater field studded with launched envelopes; a lime capture net is being strung across it.

title: Unread counter
start: A mechanical counter showing a small unread number beside an inbox tray.
end: The counter spins faster than it can be read, digits roll over and the drum rattles loose.
apocalypse: Jammed slot machines stand in a silent arcade ruin; a lime reset lever is pulled on the first one.

title: Signature attachment snowdrift
start: An email envelope with two tiny logo-image tiles clipped to it.
end: Every reply adds more tiny image tiles until a snowdrift of icons buries the thread.
apocalypse: A flattened claw machine in icon rubble; a lime filter screen separates the message from the clutter.

title: File locked by another user
start: A document folder with a small graphite padlock on the clasp.
end: Waiting copies line up at the lock; more padlocks clamp onto each copy.
apocalypse: A heap of rusted padlocks fused together; a lime master-key rig works its way through.

title: Sync conflict copies
start: A frosted cloud-shaped canister syncing one document down a tube.
end: Two versions collide in the tube and conflicted copies branch off, multiplying down side pipes.
apocalypse: A collapsed chairlift over a field of duplicates; a lime merge press compacts them into one.

title: Request access door
start: A document visible behind a frosted glass door with a request slot.
end: Request slips pile up in the slot and spill across the floor; the door never opens.
apocalypse: Buried turnstiles in a drift of request slips; a lime gate mechanism is being installed.

title: Comment pileup
start: A draft page on a stand with three small comment flags pinned in the margin.
end: Comment flags multiply until the page is a pincushion that can no longer be read.
apocalypse: A flattened pinball field studded with flags; lime sweepers resolve and clear a lane.

title: Markup sediment
start: A clean page with a single tracked-change strike mark.
end: Layer after layer of markup overlays stack until the page is a thick translucent block.
apocalypse: A sedimentary cliff of markup layers; a lime core drill extracts the clean original.

title: Downloads folder landslide
start: A small download tray catching a few files from a chute.
end: Duplicate downloads pour in faster than the tray can hold and it overflows across the desk.
apocalypse: A compacted ball-pit crater; a lime sorter sifts it into labelled bins.

title: Storage full
start: A frosted storage canister with a gauge needle near the top.
end: The canister bursts at the seams and files spray out across the table.
apocalypse: A collapsed water tower in a flooded file plain; a lime pipeline routes flow into new tanks.

title: Missing font
start: A layout tray of type blocks with one empty slot.
end: Mismatched substitute blocks are forced in and the press jams, bending the frame.
apocalypse: A shattered press surrounded by scattered type blocks; a lime rack rebuilds the set.

title: Broken slide template
start: A small deck of slides on an easel, each element seated in its grid.
end: Elements drift off the grid slide by slide until they pile in the corners.
apocalypse: Slide tiles scattered across a wide plain; a lime grid frame re-seats them.

title: Screenshot of a spreadsheet
start: A camera on a tripod photographing a printed spreadsheet sheet.
end: Photos of the photo are taken and passed along, each flatter and less usable than the last.
apocalypse: A dune of photo strips; a lime scanner converts the first strip back into live cells.

title: Sorted one column
start: A two-column tile tray where each row's tiles are paired by a lime link.
end: One column is sorted alone; rows slide apart and every pair is mismatched.
apocalypse: Derailed coaster cars piled in a ravine; a lime coupler reattaches the correct pairs.

title: Filter left on
start: A spreadsheet tray with a small funnel filter clipped to one column.
end: Filtered rows drop through the floor into a hidden compartment and silently accumulate.
apocalypse: An underground cavern of hidden rows; a lime lift brings them back to the surface.

title: Merged cells
start: A grid of frosted acrylic cells with two merged into one.
end: Merges spread across the grid until nothing can be sorted or split.
apocalypse: A monolithic fused slab across the landscape; a lime saw cuts it back into cells.

title: #REF chain collapse
start: A chain of formula linkage rods connecting cells on a tabletop.
end: One rod is pulled; the linkage collapses cell by cell down the table.
apocalypse: Scattered rods and marbles across a ruin; a lime linkage rig reconnects the chain.

title: Encoding garbage
start: Clean data tiles feeding into a small converter box.
end: The converter spits out scrambled, abstract glyph tiles that clog the output tray.
apocalypse: A mound of scrambled tiles; a lime decoder frame restores them.

title: Date format swap
start: Two flip-panel date stamps side by side.
end: Day and month panels swap; schedules misfire and paper deadlines tumble.
apocalypse: Flip panels scattered across a plain; a lime aligner snaps them back into order.

title: Duplicate CRM contacts
start: A small card file of contact cards.
end: Each card duplicates itself until the drawers burst.
apocalypse: Drifts of duplicate cards; a lime dedupe press stacks unique cards.

title: Empty merge field
start: A batch of envelopes on a conveyor, each with an empty bracketed slot.
end: The batch ships out with blank slots and returns stamped back.
apocalypse: Returned envelopes piled around a derailed coaster; a lime stamp fills slots.

title: Attribution tug-of-war
start: One conversion token tied to two channel ropes on a desk.
end: More ropes attach and pull in every direction until the token tears.
apocalypse: Snapped ropes over a ruined arena; a lime ledger mechanism splits the token fairly.

title: Stale pivot
start: A pivot-table model with a refresh crank.
end: The crank is forgotten; the model drifts out of step with the incoming data feed that piles up behind it.
apocalypse: A seized scrambler ride half-buried in unprocessed data; a lime crank drive restarts it.

title: Forced update
start: A laptop on a desk with a physical progress bar stand beside it.
end: The progress bar stalls, rewinds and loops while work piles up next to it.
apocalypse: A rusted loop track over a dead desk city; a lime exit track is being welded.

title: VPN drop
start: A frosted acrylic tunnel pipe between a laptop and a server block.
end: The tunnel keeps collapsing and packets pile up at the breaks.
apocalypse: A caved-in tunnel under a ruin; lime shoring braces the passage.

title: 2FA code sprint
start: A code-token device on a shelf across the room from the laptop.
end: Codes expire before they arrive; tokens pile up mid-route.
apocalypse: A cracked mole-board ruin; a lime key fits one hole.

title: Adapter stack
start: A laptop with one port and a single graphite adapter block.
end: Adapters stack on adapters into a teetering tower.
apocalypse: Toppled adapter towers in rubble; a lime single hub stands upright.

title: Wi-Fi dead zone
start: A router with frosted signal rings spreading over a desk grid.
end: A dead zone grows; rings break and desks fall dark.
apocalypse: Scattered rings over a dark plain; lime repeaters relight a path.

title: Subscription sprawl
start: One subscription card in a small holder.
end: Cards multiply and a billing conveyor starts feeding them out endlessly.
apocalypse: Ticket drifts across a ruined midway; a lime consolidator winds them into one roll.

title: Broken integration
start: Two gear systems linked by one lime coupling.
end: The coupling snaps; each gear system spins on its own, throwing work off.
apocalypse: Two gear ruins facing each other across a gap; a lime coupling bridges them.

title: Retry storm
start: A message cube fired down a chute to a receiving tray.
end: The receiver doesn't answer; retries multiply until cubes jam the chute.
apocalypse: A heap of cubes around a toppled pitching machine; a lime backoff valve meters flow.

title: Battery death
start: A laptop with a battery gauge falling toward empty.
end: The laptop dies mid-task; chargers are hunted across the office, leaving work half-done.
apocalypse: Dead cars across a rink ruin; a lime charging grid powers the first car back up.

title: License seats full
start: A rack of seat tokens, every slot full, one token waiting.
end: Waiting tokens queue, and seats are pried loose to make room.
apocalypse: A collapsed carousel ringed by waiting tokens; a lime rack adds seats.

title: Make the logo bigger
start: A tidy ivory layout board with a small graphite mark block in one corner and content blocks seated on a lime grid.
end: The mark block swells in steps, shoving headline and image blocks to the edges until they topple off the board.
apocalypse: A deflated bounce house draped over flattened layout blocks across a wide plain; a lime grid frame is lowered to restore proportion.

title: Brief ping-pong
start: A single brief sheet resting between two graphite in-trays on a desk.
end: The brief shuttles between the trays, collecting clipped notes on every pass until the stack is too heavy to land in either.
apocalypse: The pendulum ship lies broken between two ruined platforms buried in clipped notes; a lime anchor pins the brief to one tray.

title: Proofing rounds
start: A proof sheet under a small graphite stamp press with a mechanical round counter.
end: The counter ticks up each round and a new proof slides out; proofs stack in a leaning column beside the press.
apocalypse: A mountain of proofs around a seized round-up ride; a lime final-stamp arm descends on the top sheet.

title: Stock photo licensing
start: Three small photo prints on a rail, each with a lime licence tag tied on a string.
end: Strings tangle and tags drop off as more prints are added; untagged prints spill across the table.
apocalypse: A collapsed prize wall in a field of loose prints; a lime ledger rail threads tags back onto their prints.

title: Colour mismatch
start: A glowing screen swatch beside a printed paper swatch, slightly off in tone.
end: Each print copied from the last drifts further in tone; a stack of increasingly wrong swatches fans across the desk.
apocalypse: A shattered colour wheel spread across a grey basin; a lime calibration rig realigns the first segment.

title: File too big to send
start: An oversized graphite file crate in front of a narrow mail slot.
end: The crate wedges in the slot, splits, and its chunks scatter down the chute unevenly.
apocalypse: Crate fragments piled at a collapsed tunnel mouth; a lime conveyor widens the passage.

title: Expired transfer link
start: A pneumatic courier tube carrying one file cartridge, a small countdown dial on the tube.
end: The dial runs out mid-route; cartridges drop from the tubes onto the floor.
apocalypse: Broken tube ruins with cartridges scattered beneath them; a lime tube is reconnected across the gap.

title: Ad size explosion
start: One finished ad frame on a small easel.
end: One small change must be repeated across dozens of frame sizes that fan out around the easel.
apocalypse: Stacks of mismatched frames fill a ruined gallery; a lime resizing rig works through them one by one.

title: Tracking tag chaos
start: Link tokens with neat lime tags entering one clear tracking pipe.
end: Inconsistently tagged tokens enter; the pipe branches and tokens flow into the wrong channels.
apocalypse: Silted, overgrown channels crisscross a delta; a lime sluice gate reroutes tokens into one channel.

title: Midnight scheduled post
start: A small posting queue feeding a publishing slot, a timer dial on top.
end: The dial slips; posts fire out of the slot into a darkened overnight room.
apocalypse: A fallen cuckoo clock in a dark landscape; a lime dial is set and the first door closes.

title: Everything is urgent
start: A row of task cards on a desk; one carries a small lime flag.
end: Flags are added to every card, then flags to the flags, until the work disappears under them.
apocalypse: A flag-strewn ruin at landscape scale; a lime sorting rack raises only the few flags that matter.

title: Got a sec?
start: A focus block sitting on a small desk platform.
end: Tapping arms nudge the block off its platform again and again; each time it lands further away.
apocalypse: A cracked dunk tank in a flooded ruin; a lime shield holds the block on its platform.

title: Context switching
start: Six task trays arranged around a small rotating desk.
end: The desk spins between trays faster and faster; each task is started and abandoned half-done.
apocalypse: A seized tilt-a-whirl among half-finished tasks; a lime brake locks the desk facing one tray.

title: Blocked by another team
start: Two conveyor lines meeting at a single graphite gate.
end: The gate stays shut; work piles up on the waiting line and spills over the rails.
apocalypse: A rusted lift hill with piled cars; a lime chain drive restarts the climb.

title: Duplicate work
start: Two identical workbenches side by side, each building the same part.
end: Identical parts pile up on both benches, neither aware of the other.
apocalypse: Twin wrecks lie side by side; a lime merge track combines them into one line.

title: Single point of knowledge
start: A small vault with one graphite key module slotted into its door.
end: The key module is removed; everything that needs the vault queues at the door.
apocalypse: A sealed vault ruin surrounded by queued work; a lime rig duplicates the key.

title: Vague ticket
start: A blank ticket card in an intake tray.
end: Clarification loops orbit the card and multiply until the tray is ringed with them.
apocalypse: A seized orbiter above a crater; a lime arm stamps a clear diagram onto the card.

title: Purchase order relay
start: A purchase-order form on a tray with three signature slots.
end: More slots appear across departments; the form travels tray to tray and never returns.
apocalypse: A ruined track littered with forms; a lime baton carries one form across the finish.

title: Signature chase
start: A document on a small rail cart with signature stops along the route.
end: The cart stalls at each stop; a queue of carts builds behind it.
apocalypse: A derailed train in a ruin; a lime bypass track skips the stalled stops.

title: Net-90 invoice
start: An invoice envelope resting in a waiting tray.
end: Reminder envelopes pile on top; the tray sinks under the weight.
apocalypse: A frozen racetrack buried in reminders; a lime conveyor moves the first invoice across the line.

title: Thermostat war
start: One thermostat dial on a miniature office wall above a row of desks.
end: The dial swings back and forth; frost creeps over some desks while others shimmer with heat.
apocalypse: A cracked plain, half frozen and half scorched; a lime regulator balances the zones.

title: Kitchen mug tower
start: One unwashed mug left in a small ivory office-kitchen sink.
end: Mugs are stacked on the first one, rim on rim, until a leaning tower rises out of the sink and over the counter.
apocalypse: A landscape of mug shards around a toppled ride hub; a lime rack is sorting out the few intact mugs.

title: Hot-desk shuffle
start: One desk with a lime booking tag and a small, tidy set of belongings.
end: Desks slide into new positions on floor rails; belongings are left behind and scatter across the aisles.
apocalypse: Desks scattered across a cracked plain; a lime floor grid is laid down and assigns each one a place.

title: Dead whiteboard marker
start: A whiteboard with one faint, streaky stroke and a marker tray below.
end: Each dead marker is dropped back into the tray and a new one tried, until they spill onto the floor.
apocalypse: A drift of dead markers below a toppled whiteboard; a lime refill station starts filling the first one.

title: Empty supply closet
start: A supply shelf with one sticky-note pad left on it.
end: The shelf empties and small hoards of supplies form on desks around the closet.
apocalypse: Collapsed shelving in a quiet ruin; a lime conveyor restocks the first shelf.

title: Mailroom parcel pile
start: A single parcel on a clean mailroom counter.
end: Parcels arrive faster than they are sorted, stacking until the mailroom walls bow outward.
apocalypse: A parcel landslide filling a valley; a lime sorting chute routes them into lanes.

title: Badge reader standoff
start: A small badge reader beside a frosted glass door.
end: The reader rejects every badge; a queue of badges on lanyards stacks up at the door.
apocalypse: A collapsed door frame in badge rubble; a lime reader lights and the gate opens.

title: Projector aspect mismatch
start: A projector casting a slightly cropped image onto a small screen.
end: The crop worsens and content spills off the screen onto the walls and ceiling.
apocalypse: A torn canopy across a ruin; a lime frame resets the image to fit.

title: Shredder jam
start: A small shredder with one sheet feeding into its mouth.
end: The shredder jams and shreds erupt from every seam.
apocalypse: Shred drifts across a plain; a lime compactor bales them.

title: Sticky-note wall collapse
start: A wall with a few square notes in neat rows.
end: Notes are layered on notes until their weight peels the whole stack off the wall.
apocalypse: A fallen wall of notes like a scree slope; a lime frame re-hangs them in order.

title: Report nobody reads
start: A bound report on a delivery tray outside a closed door.
end: Reports keep arriving on schedule; unread stacks rise beside the door.
apocalypse: Unread stacks form a canyon; a lime reader arm lifts one page to the light.

title: Mandatory training module
start: A training cartridge slotted into a laptop.
end: New policy cartridges queue behind it; progress resets each time one is added.
apocalypse: A ruined obstacle course; a lime track cuts straight across it.

title: Survey fatigue
start: A single survey card in an inbox tray.
end: Survey cards pile up faster than they're answered, most of them blank.
apocalypse: A plinko ruin buried in blank cards; a lime collector gathers the few answered ones.

title: Review form maze
start: A short performance form with a handful of boxes.
end: Boxes multiply across new pages until the form is a stack of grids.
apocalypse: A box-strewn maze ruin; a lime path marks the way through.

title: Reorg shuffle
start: An org chart of frosted acrylic blocks linked by lime rods.
end: The blocks reshuffle again and again; rods snap and hang loose.
apocalypse: Toppled blocks across a wide plain; a lime frame rebuilds a simple chart.

title: Budget reallocation
start: Budget tokens in colour-banded bins on a desk.
end: Tokens are shifted between bins until none of them balance and some overflow.
apocalypse: A dry, seized water wheel; a lime balancing beam levels the bins.

title: Vendor onboarding forms
start: A thin vendor form packet on a clipboard.
end: Forms multiply into a tall, leaning stack.
apocalypse: A dune of forms; a lime binder clamps them into one packet.

title: Tool migration
start: An old graphite system block beside a new frosted one, joined by a transfer bridge.
end: The bridge sags mid-transfer and data blocks fall between the systems.
apocalypse: A collapsed bridge over a gorge full of data blocks; a lime span reconnects the platforms.

title: Stale wiki
start: A shelf of ivory binders with a few dusty spines.
end: Binders yellow and contradict each other; the shelf sags.
apocalypse: A collapsed library ruin; a lime rack re-indexes the current pages.

title: Search finds nothing
start: A card-catalog drawer with a search probe hovering over it.
end: The probe opens the wrong drawers and spills cards everywhere.
apocalypse: A spilled catalog ruin; a lime index rail sorts the cards.

title: Broken link
start: A chain of page tiles connected by lime links.
end: One link breaks; everything travelling down the chain falls through the gap.
apocalypse: A monorail ruin spanning a chasm; a lime section is lowered into the gap.

title: Cache not cleared
start: A display case showing an older page model while a new one waits beside it.
end: New versions stack behind the glass, but the old one stays in front.
apocalypse: A dusty display ruin; a lime wiper clears the glass.

title: Works on my machine
start: A working mechanism on one desk rig.
end: The mechanism moves to a second desk and falls apart piece by piece.
apocalypse: A collapsed trapeze between two towers; a lime platform matches both sides.

title: Placeholder shipped
start: A layout block of grey placeholder bars on a conveyor.
end: Placeholder blocks ship out on the conveyor into the world.
apocalypse: Grey blocks across a ruin; a lime stamp replaces them one by one.

title: Heavy page
start: A page tile carrying oversized image slabs.
end: The page bows under the weight and slows to a crawl.
apocalypse: A crushed page ruin; a lime compressor lightens the slabs.

title: Form to nowhere
start: A form slot on a web page model feeding into a pipe.
end: Submissions drop into the pipe, which leads nowhere.
apocalypse: Submissions pooled at the slide's broken end; a lime pipe reroutes them.

title: Staging vs production
start: Two identical platforms, one marked with a lime band.
end: Changes are pushed to the wrong platform.
apocalypse: Twin ruins; a lime marker picks out production.

title: Friday hotfix
start: A small patch plate over a crack.
end: The patch cracks further and more patches are bolted over it.
apocalypse: A patchwork ruin; a lime brace spans the crack.

title: QA ticket bounce
start: A ticket between a build tray and a QA tray.
end: The ticket bounces between them, collecting stamps.
apocalypse: A torn trampoline; a lime catch holds the ticket.

title: Sprint carryover
start: A sprint tray of task cards.
end: Unfinished cards carry over and pile into the next tray.
apocalypse: A derailed train; a lime sorter clears the cards.

title: Cover-sheet memo
start: A single report on a desk with a missing cover sheet and one memo clipped to it.
end: Duplicate reminder memos arrive by tube, by tray and by pin, each clipping to the report until it is buried in identical memos.
apocalypse: A drift of memos entombs a ruined cubicle row; a lime binder clamps the single report with its cover sheet.

title: Exiled stapler
start: A lime stapler on a tidy desk, its place outlined on the blotter.
end: The stapler is moved desk by desk down a corridor, then down a stairwell into a dim basement storage room.
apocalypse: A flooded basement ruin full of relocated desk objects; a lime lift carries the stapler back up.

title: Printer taken to the field
start: A printer on a stand showing a paper-jam error light, one crumpled sheet in its tray.
end: The printer is wheeled out of the office on a cart, across a car park and into an open grass field.
apocalypse: Printer fragments scattered across a scorched field; a lime repair rig reassembles a working paper path.

title: Flair quota
start: A uniform on a hanger with a few round pin badges fixed to its strap.
end: More pins are demanded; the strap fills, then the sleeves, until the uniform sags under the metal.
apocalypse: A heap of loose pins around a collapsed wheel; a lime magnet lifts them into one small tray.

title: Saturday request
start: A weekend calendar page with a single sticky request slip on Saturday.
end: Slips spread to Sunday, then across the next weekend and the one after, covering every rest day.
apocalypse: A ruined calendar Ferris wheel fallen across a quiet town; a lime lock seals the weekend gondolas.

title: Lane-switch commute
start: A miniature highway model with two lanes of tiny cars and one car switching lanes.
end: Every lane change lands in the slower lane; the switching car ends up further behind.
apocalypse: A cracked highway ruin with cars stalled in both lanes; a lime express lane opens down the middle.

title: Desk to storage B
start: A single cubicle near a window, its nameplate blank and its chair tucked in.
end: The cubicle is shrunk, moved, shrunk again and pushed deeper into the building until it sits beside the boiler room.
apocalypse: A cubicle half-buried in basement rubble; a lime light rig pushes up through the ceiling.

title: Efficiency consultants
start: A clipboard audit form on an interview table with two empty chairs facing one.
end: The questions multiply; audit forms stack; desks get tagged for removal one by one.
apocalypse: A tagged-desk graveyard across a plain; a lime sorter returns the useful desks to service.

title: Insomnia copier
start: A copier producing one crisp copy of a document.
end: Copies are made of copies through the night, each fainter and grainier until the stack is mostly grey.
apocalypse: A grey dune of illegible copies under night light; a lime scanner recovers the original.

title: Catalogue apartment
start: A tidy flat-pack furniture box on a studio floor, an office badge on top.
end: The room fills with identical catalogue furniture until it's more showroom than home, the badge lost beneath.
apocalypse: A collapsed showroom ruin; a lime path clears one real room in the middle.

title: Single-serving travel
start: A tray table with a single-portion meal, a tiny soap and a boarding stub.
end: Single-use portions multiply per trip until the tray table overflows with tiny packages.
apocalypse: A landfill of tiny portions around a ruined conveyor; a lime compactor sorts them.

title: Recall formula
start: A brass balance scale with one small car model on one pan and a thin stack of claim forms on the other.
end: Claim forms keep landing on the pan; instead of fixing the car, the scale is recalibrated again and again while cars queue behind it.
apocalypse: A snapped scale in a scrapyard of cars and paper; a lime lever re-seats the beam and levels it.

title: Drive-thru downshift
start: A leather briefcase leaning against a tiny drive-thru window model, a paper headset beside it.
end: The briefcase is set aside; order slips stream through the window and a car queue wraps around the building.
apocalypse: A cracked, empty drive-thru lot at dusk; a lime lane marking peels off toward open road.

title: Two lines lit
start: A desk phone with two line buttons, one glowing lime.
end: The second line lights, then extension phones stack on the desk, every line glowing and every receiver off its cradle.
apocalypse: A quiet field of dead handsets around a collapsed switchboard; a lime line reconnects one call.

title: Locked leads
start: A locked drawer of index cards beside a cold desk phone on a rainy-night desk.
end: Every desk waits on the drawer; phones pile up untouched while the lock stays shut.
apocalypse: A broken lock-box ruin under grey rain; a lime key finally turns in the drawer.

title: Sales leaderboard
start: A wall leaderboard of blank graphite bars, one lime bar slightly ahead.
end: The bars race each other up the wall, bend, jam into the ceiling and start pulling the board off its mounts.
apocalypse: Fallen bars across a ruined sales floor; a lime scale lays them side by side evenly.

title: Locked coffee
start: A coffee pot behind a small locked glass cabinet door.
end: Empty mugs queue in front of the cabinet, row after row, while the pot stays sealed.
apocalypse: A dry pot in a dusty cabinet among mug shards; a lime tap reopens the flow.

title: Fluorescent hum
start: A long grey corridor model with one flickering fluorescent tube.
end: Every tube starts flickering in turn; the corridor stretches into the distance, greyer with each fixture.
apocalypse: A dim grey ruin of fallen light fixtures; a single lime lamp lights a path out.

title: Half-height floor
start: An office floor model with a ceiling at half height, a desk hunched beneath it.
end: The ceiling sinks further; chairs fold, file cabinets tip, and the room compresses.
apocalypse: A crushed floor between two intact storeys; a lime jack lifts the ceiling back up.

title: Scripted commute
start: A perfect miniature cul-de-sac with one car leaving a driveway, a briefcase on its roof rack.
end: Every element repeats on cue: the same newspaper, the same revolving door, the same desk, and the loop tightens.
apocalypse: A cracked painted-sky dome over a model town; a lime door opens in the horizon.

title: Mailroom deluge
start: One parcel on a sorting table in a cavernous mailroom.
end: Parcels and letters flood down chutes faster than any sorting arm can move, burying the table.
apocalypse: A parcel landslide filling a vast hall; a lime sorting chute restores lanes.

title: Called in on a day off
start: A shop shutter half raised, a day-off calendar page pinned beside it.
end: The shutter jams at half height; shift tasks spill under it and pile around the calendar page.
apocalypse: A jammed shutter in a ruined parade of shops; a lime crank lifts it.

title: Rental drop-box overflow
start: A return drop-box at a shop door with one tape case in the slot.
end: Returns overflow the box and spill across the pavement, cases cracking open.
apocalypse: A drift of cases outside a shuttered store; a lime conveyor sorts them back to shelves.

title: Impossible sweetener
start: A single coffee cup on a saucer beside one specific sweetener packet.
end: Wrong packets are rejected one by one; cups multiply along the desk while the right packet can't be found.
apocalypse: A spill of cups and packets across a ruin; a lime tray holds the one correct packet.

title: Late-night book delivery
start: A bound mock-up book at the foot of a townhouse staircase at night.
end: The staircase lengthens with each step; the book gets heavier and more pages are added.
apocalypse: A collapsed staircase in a quiet street; a lime lift carries the book to the door.

title: Coffee-run relay
start: A cardboard coffee tray holding one cup, steam rising.
end: The order grows to stacks of trays; cups go cold waiting and the tray stack sways.
apocalypse: A spilled coffee delta across a city block; a lime tray rescues one warm cup.

title: Autopilot remote
start: A universal remote resting beside a desk calendar.
end: The remote fast-forwards the calendar; pages fly off in a blur and the desk ages around it.
apocalypse: A desk buried under dust and pages in a faded ruin; a lime pause key stops the drift.

title: Say yes to everything
start: An inbox tray holding a single request slip.
end: An auto-approve stamp says yes to every slip; approvals blizzard out of the tray and fill the room.
apocalypse: An avalanche of approval tokens over a city; a lime filter lets only a few pass.

title: Stopwatch logistics
start: A stopwatch strapped to one parcel on a sorting belt.
end: Every parcel gets its own stopwatch; the belt speeds up until parcels fly off the end.
apocalypse: Parcels washed up on a deserted beach ruin; a lime raft carries one home.

title: Door vault conveyor
start: One plain door clicking into a tall vault rack on a rail.
end: The rack speeds up; doors jam, swing open and pile up on the rails.
apocalypse: A collapsed vault of scattered doors; a lime rack reorders them.

title: File your paperwork
start: A clipboard of paperwork on a service counter with a small window.
end: Paperwork piles on the counter while the window stays shut; a queue of clipboards forms.
apocalypse: A paper dune around a ruined counter; a lime filing arm starts filing.

title: Quota canister
start: A glass canister with a daily-quota gauge, nearly empty.
end: The canister never fills; more canisters line up, each lower than the last.
apocalypse: Empty canisters across a ruin; a lime gauge fills one to the line.

title: Production line escape
start: A small conveyor production line with a single hatch.
end: The line speeds up; product jams at the hatch and backs up the belts.
apocalypse: A jammed factory ruin at dawn; a lime gate opens onto a field.

title: Tunnel conformity
start: An identical row of shovels at identical stations.
end: Tunnels branch in perfect copies; one tunnel breaks the pattern and the rest start caving in.
apocalypse: A collapsed tunnel colony under a meadow; a lime shaft lifts toward the light.

title: Forms in triplicate
start: A form with two carbon copies beneath it on a clipboard.
end: Carbons multiply; every form spawns three more until the stack towers overhead.
apocalypse: A form dune across a bureaucratic ruin; a lime binder clamps one copy.

title: Files inside the computer
start: A beige computer tower beside a file folder on a desk.
end: Nobody can find the files; the tower is opened, then dismantled piece by piece across the desk.
apocalypse: Computer shards spread across a plain; a lime drive glows with the files intact.

title: Door falls off the car
start: A sales sample case on the seat of a small old car.
end: A door drops off; samples spill along the road as the car keeps driving.
apocalypse: A roadside ruin of parts and samples; a lime tow hitch drags the car back.

title: Cold-call phone bank
start: A single phone on a bare desk in a large open room.
end: Phones multiply into a trading floor of handsets, all ringing, stacked on every surface.
apocalypse: A silent floor of dead handsets; a lime line connects one call.

title: Save the shop
start: A small shop counter with a till and a rent notice.
end: Rent notices pile on the counter until it sinks.
apocalypse: A shuttered shop ruin; a lime key reopens the door.

title: Box on the way out
start: A cardboard box on a desk beside a studio badge.
end: Belongings are boxed and the box is carried down a long corridor.
apocalypse: A dim studio ruin; a lime spotlight picks out the box.

title: Temp supply mystery
start: A stocked supply shelf beside a small temp desk with a visitor badge on it.
end: Items vanish from the shelf one by one; desk drawers lock and small lamps angle toward the temp desk.
apocalypse: An emptied, dust-covered shelving ruin; a lime inventory scanner sweeps the aisle and finds the stash.

title: Plaque race
start: A long big-box store aisle with one empty wall-plaque frame at the end.
end: Carts race down the aisle, knocking stock off shelves as more and more empty frames appear on the wall.
apocalypse: A collapsed aisle of fallen shelving and dented carts; a lime cart rolls clear with the frame.

title: Pudding loophole
start: One pudding cup on a stockroom shelf beside a clipped coupon.
end: Pudding cups are bought and stacked until they fill the stockroom and roll out into the warehouse aisles.
apocalypse: A dune of pudding cups across a warehouse ruin; a lime pallet jack hauls one tidy pallet away.

title: Honesty in the meeting
start: A polished meeting table with one agenda sheet and one pen.
end: Each blunt answer tips something over; papers slide, chairs roll back and the agenda sheet tears.
apocalypse: A boardroom ruin with a split table; one lime chair stands upright at its head.

title: Eight-to-noon window
start: A wall clock with a lime arc from eight to twelve beside a front door.
end: The arc stretches past noon and round again; waiting chairs line up down the hallway.
apocalypse: A clock fallen across a ruined hallway; a lime door finally swings open.

title: Auto-layoff machine
start: A row of desks with a slim automated evaluation box on each one.
end: The boxes flag desks automatically; flagged desks are ejected out of the row on rails.
apocalypse: A field of ejected desks around a burnt-out control box; a lime rig restores one row.

title: Stock goes to zero
start: A brass stock gauge on an executive desk, its lime needle high.
end: The needle drops; furniture is carted out, lamps switched off, the office emptied around the gauge.
apocalypse: An empty office ruin with the gauge on the floor; a lime needle starts to lift.

title: Unpaid internship
start: A briefcase beside a heavy medical-equipment case at a bus stop.
end: The case gets heavier every stop; the commute route stretches across the city.
apocalypse: A dim city ruin on a hillside; a lime tram carries the case to the top.

title: Wiped project memory
start: A small envelope of random personal items on a desk.
end: The items don't explain the project; the desk fills with unexplained objects and unanswered notes.
apocalypse: A dim ruin of scattered objects; a lime thread links them in order.

title: Erase the bad project
inspired_by: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004)
start: A project folder on a desk under a lamp.
end: The desk, then the room, begins to dissolve at the edges as the project is erased piece by piece.
apocalypse: A ruin with blurred, missing edges; a lime outline redraws the room.

title: Jet-lagged work trip
start: A hotel-room desk with a laptop and a bedside clock at 3 a.m.
end: Clocks multiply across the desk, each showing a different time, and the city lights outside blur.
apocalypse: A dim skyline ruin; a lime clock settles on one time.

title: Corporate gym
start: A treadmill positioned beside an office desk.
end: Desks are pulled onto treadmills, then onto rowing machines, until work happens only in motion.
apocalypse: A gym ruin with fallen equipment; a lime bench stands clear.

title: Teleprompter runaway
start: A teleprompter showing blank grey lines.
end: The prompter scrolls faster and faster; scripts spill off the rollers.
apocalypse: A studio ruin buried in script paper; a lime prompter scrolls at a steady pace.

title: Concession overflow
start: A cinema concession stand with a popcorn machine.
end: Popcorn overflows the kettle, the counter and then the lobby.
apocalypse: A popcorn dune over a ruined lobby; a lime scoop clears a path.

title: Billable hours
start: A time card on a mahogany law desk.
end: Time cards stack on the desk until it sinks into the floor under their weight.
apocalypse: A time-card dune around a sunken desk; a lime punch clock resets.

title: Cloned yourself
start: One desk with one chair and one coffee mug.
end: Copies of the desk appear side by side, each slightly worse than the last copy.
apocalypse: A ruin of degraded desk copies; a lime frame keeps only the original.

title: Undercoat upsell
start: A car-lot sales desk with a single add-on form.
end: Add-on forms stack onto every sale until the paperwork outweighs the car.
apocalypse: A snowy car-lot ruin; a lime car drives away with one form.

title: Can't drop below pace
start: A deadline speedometer on a desk with a lime minimum marker.
end: The needle can't drop below the marker; every task is done at speed and things fly off the desk.
apocalypse: A broken highway ruin; a lime brake finally engages.

title: Systems are down
start: A control-room console with one blinking warning lamp.
end: Systems cascade offline one by one; security doors slide open along a corridor.
apocalypse: An overgrown control-room ruin; a lime switch reboots the grid.

title: Sinking launch
start: A product-launch model riding on a tabletop sea.
end: The launch lists to one side; lifeboats are cut from the budget one by one.
apocalypse: A sunken launch on the sea floor; a lime lifeboat carries the salvage.

title: Booby-trapped office
start: A desk with a single tripwire stretched across a doorway.
end: The trap triggers another trap, and another, cascading through the office.
apocalypse: A trap-strewn office ruin; a lime path clears through it.

title: Square filter, round hole
start: A square filter beside a round slot on a console.
end: Improvised fixes pile up with tape, hoses and binder covers.
apocalypse: A capsule-like ruin; a lime adapter fits the square into the round.

title: Shifting cube rooms
start: A single cube-shaped room with hatches on all six sides.
end: The rooms slide and rotate; every hatch leads to another identical room.
apocalypse: A stacked cube ruin; a lime hatch opens to the outside.

title: Contract takes your name
start: A contract sheet on a desk with a nameplate beside it.
end: The nameplate fades as contracts pile higher.
apocalypse: A misty ruin of contract piles; a lime nameplate glows again.

title: Denied claims cubicle
start: A cramped cubicle with a single claim form and a rubber stamp.
end: Every claim is stamped denied; the cubicle walls close in as the stack grows.
apocalypse: A crushed cubicle ruin; a lime stamp approves one claim.

title: Task board stampede
start: A board game of task tiles on a desk with a pair of dice.
end: A roll releases a stampede of task tiles that tramples the office.
apocalypse: A trampled office ruin; a lime board resets to start.

title: Thawed and outdated
inspired_by: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)
start: A cryo-chamber beside a desk with an old beige computer.
end: The desk thaws decades later, surrounded by equipment it can't plug into.
apocalypse: A ruin of outdated equipment; a lime adapter connects the old to the new.

title: Overqualified at the counter
start: A record-store counter with a stack of list cards.
end: Lists pile up; the queue waits; the stack topples.
apocalypse: A record-shop ruin; a lime needle drops on one record.

title: System erased you
start: An employee file folder on a desk.
end: The file is erased; the badge stops opening doors, and the desk is cleared.
apocalypse: A data-vault ruin; a lime file is restored to the drawer.

title: Daily sample check
start: A sleek entry turnstile with a small sample reader, one lime light waiting at the gate.
end: Each morning the check gets stricter; a second reader is bolted on, then a third, and the queue of badges snakes back through the lobby.
apocalypse: A turnstile ruin in a vast, clean, abandoned lobby; a lime gate slides open beside the readers.

title: Midnight reorg
start: An office floor under a night sky seen through tall windows, desks in neat rows.
end: At midnight the walls slide, floors rotate and desks rearrange while the lights are off; by morning nothing is where it was.
apocalypse: A tangle of half-rotated floors and misplaced desks under a dark sky; a lime floor plan is laid out and walls lock into place.

title: Daily re-onboarding
start: An onboarding cassette and a welcome packet waiting on a fresh desk each morning.
end: Each day starts from the same tape; welcome packets pile up, unread past page one.
apocalypse: A shoreline ruin of unspooled tape and welcome packets; a lime cassette ejects with a single saved note.

title: Photo-note handoff
start: A desk scattered with a few instant-photo notes, each with a blank caption strip.
end: Context is lost between shifts; photos multiply, contradict each other and cover the walls in overlapping layers.
apocalypse: A ruin of faded photos drifting across a motel-like courtyard; a lime thread links them in the right order.

title: Seven-day countdown
start: A countdown dial on a desk with seven lit segments beside one project folder.
end: Segments go dark one by one while the folder stays unopened and tasks pile up around it.
apocalypse: A stone-well-shaped ruin of stacked folders; a lime rope is lowered to lift the project out.

title: Office chain reaction
start: A small desk fan pointed at a loose stack of paper next to a full coffee cup.
end: One sheet lifts; it tips the cup, which shorts a power strip, which drops a shelf, which topples the next desk in a chain.
apocalypse: A chain of toppled desks and shelves across a wide ruin; a lime stop block halts the last link.

title: Golden ticket line
start: A factory conveyor carrying neatly wrapped bars past a single inspection station.
end: The line speeds up; wrappers tear and pile; the inspector station is buried in bars.
apocalypse: A silent factory ruin with dried rivers and stopped belts; a lime conveyor restarts one lane.

title: Frozen clock
start: An office clock frozen at 4:59, a desk beneath it.
end: Everything freezes except the task pile on the desk, which keeps growing while the clock refuses to move.
apocalypse: A frost-bound office ruin; a lime second hand begins to tick.

title: Road not taken
start: A briefcase beside a toolbox at a fork in a miniature path.
end: Two versions of the day split down each path, both piling up unfinished.
apocalypse: Two ruined paths across a valley; a lime bridge joins them.

title: Blinking drive
start: A server rack with one blinking drive among dark ones.
end: Drives blink everywhere, faster and faster, and the rack starts to overheat.
apocalypse: A cooled server ruin in a dark hall; one lime drive glows steady.

title: Sponsor clutter
start: A small basement public-access TV set with two chairs and a single contract on the table.
end: Sponsor products crowd onto the set, stacking on chairs and taping to the backdrop until the set is buried.
apocalypse: A basement studio ruin under product rubble; a lime camera pans across one clean chair.

title: Jump-to-conclusions mat
start: A floor mat of answer squares beside a desk, one square glowing lime.
end: Every decision is made by hopping onto a square; decisions pile up in random directions across the floor.
apocalypse: A cracked, scattered mat across a ruin; a lime path shows the one sensible route.

title: Ticket rail overload
start: A restaurant kitchen ticket rail with one order slip clipped to it.
end: Slips crowd the rail, overlap and spill onto the pass; plates stack under heat lamps.
apocalypse: A kitchen ruin under a drift of slips; a lime rail clips them back in order.

title: Clock-tower deadline
start: A giant clock face on an office tower with a lime hand near midnight.
end: The hand crawls toward the deadline while the floors below fill with unfinished work.
apocalypse: A snowy tower ruin with a stopped clock; a lime gear restarts it.

title: Airport form loop
start: A departure-gate counter with one stamped form and an empty queue.
end: The form is rejected again and again; the traveller's belongings stack beside the gate as the days pass.
apocalypse: A sunlit, empty terminal ruin; a lime gate finally lets one form through.

title: Supply closet heist
start: A locked supply closet with a single request form taped to the door.
end: The approval process is so slow that a heist-style plan unfolds across a table: blueprints, timers, laser-grid diagrams.
apocalypse: A dismantled vault ruin; a lime key simply opens the closet.

title: Admin-rights ceiling drop
start: A white server room with one terminal needing a single permission.
end: Getting the permission requires lowering through the ceiling on cables past sensors and alarms.
apocalypse: A white room in ruins, ceiling tiles scattered; a lime access card sits in the reader.

title: Paperwork twister
start: A single loose form on a desk near an open window.
end: Wind catches the form, then the stack, and a spiralling column of paperwork rises over the office.
apocalypse: A flattened plain strewn with paper after the storm; a lime anemometer spins calm and the forms are collected.

title: Deadline asteroid
start: A small model asteroid hovering over a desk calendar.
end: The asteroid grows as the deadline approaches; the desk team drills into it.
apocalypse: A cratered ruin; a lime drill rig splits the asteroid.

title: Prototype taken for production
start: A cardboard-and-tape prototype on a stand, clearly a mock-up.
end: The mock-up is treated as the real thing; parts are ordered, stands are built, launch plans form around it.
apocalypse: A collapsed prop ruin; a lime frame builds the real one beside it.

title: Monochrome office
start: A monochrome grey office with one lime object on a desk.
end: The grey spreads over every surface; routines repeat in black and white.
apocalypse: A grey ruin where lime colour is spreading from one desk.

title: Harvest quota
start: A small platform piled with a seasonal quota of grain.
end: The quota doubles; the platform groans and the grain spills.
apocalypse: A drought-cracked ruin; a lime conveyor delivers a fair load.

title: Citation quota
start: A ticket pad on a dashboard with a quota counter.
end: Tickets are issued for everything until the pad runs empty and the counter spins.
apocalypse: A snowy highway ruin; a lime counter resets.

title: The call you can't leave
start: A phone booth on a street corner with the receiver off the hook.
end: Work calls keep the receiver tethered; the booth shrinks around it.
apocalypse: A ruined street; a lime cord snaps free.

title: Hospitality-suite vigil
start: A hotel hospitality suite with a tray of snacks and one empty chair for the client.
end: Hours pass, snacks go stale, the tray empties and refills and the chair stays empty.
apocalypse: A dusty suite ruin; a lime chair is filled.

title: Remote volleyball coworker
start: A home desk with a volleyball propped on the chair opposite.
end: Isolation grows; notes and sticky messages pile around the ball.
apocalypse: An island ruin of home-office gear; a lime raft signals a return to the office.

title: Fifteen-minute escape hatch
start: A small hatch behind a filing cabinet with a lime handle.
end: Tasks queue up in front of it as everyone lines up for fifteen minutes away.
apocalypse: A ruined filing floor; a lime hatch reopens.

title: Dinner-table buzz
start: A dinner table set for two with a phone face-down beside the plate.
end: The phone buzzes, then again; plates cool as work floods in.
apocalypse: A dinner-table ruin; a lime cloth drapes the phone.

title: Dial-up handshake
start: A beige modem on a desk beside a tangle-free phone line.
end: The connection screeches, drops, retries, drops again.
apocalypse: A dusty modem ruin; a lime cable finally connects.

title: Forecast board
start: A weather map on an easel with one lime front line.
end: The forecast is wrong; debris hits the board.
apocalypse: A storm-battered ruin; a lime vane points steady.

title: Synergy merger
start: Two small office models side by side, each with its own org blocks.
end: They're pushed together; blocks overlap and duplicates are ejected.
apocalypse: A merged ruin; a lime frame aligns one chart.
